repair_2_float_bits_authority.frozen_evidence: worker.py:1447-1460 (row['value'] == expected_value), worker.py:166-186 (SDF_ATTRIBUTE_SPECS float expected values with expected bits), worker.py:549-551 (_float32_bits_hex struct.pack '<f')
